meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接手 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2 的收尾:确认迁移脚本已运行,测试 v2 能否收发消息,设置所有者,迁移旧记忆,核对容器配置,处理 v1 定制代码,最后验证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from v1”“finish migration”等短语时触发;需先运行过 bash migrate-v2.sh 脚本。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: Claude 会检查迁移状态并引导你完成后续步骤。
Claude 会继续处理未完成的部分。

say.text: 迁移完成后帮我验证一下
say.note: Claude 会运行验证命令并检查服务状态。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude handles post-migration steps: checks the script ran, tests v2 message routing, seeds the owner, migrates memory, reconciles container configs, ports custom v1 code, then verifies and restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions phrases like "migrate from v1" or "finish migration". Requires that `bash migrate-v2.sh` has already completed.

say_en.text: Help me finish migrating from v1 to v2
say_en.note: Claude will check the handoff and guide you.
Claude runs the verify command and checks the service.
